_schema.note: Phase 10 per-roast sensory IDEAL. Schema v6 (Step 5.5, 2026-05-22): the representation is the 10 cotter CATA attributes with a real (TDS,EY) relationship — see models.sensory.ATTRIBUTES — NOT the v5 six averaged axes. Step 5.5 dropped axis-averaging because cotter attribute values are already consumer-perceived (cross-attribute masking baked in) and averaging destroyed signal; the 7 un-fittable attributes (R²<=0.32) were dropped, each a weak twin of a kept one. LABEL CONCEPT REMOVED (blueprint §0): one 10-attribute IDEAL per roast, not N label islands. Each IDEAL = predict_attributes(**anchor_brew). anchor_brew recomputed 2026-05-22 after the brewer simplification (Layer 1 no longer has a BREWER_TAU_MULT term — XL = standard scaled by water only). Confidence tiers: medium_light = user ⭐5 feedback cup (Tier A); light = user tim feedback (provisional — tim is not a Layer 1 calibration anchor); medium / moderately_dark = deterministic placeholders (predict_attributes at medium_light's reference brew point + roast offset). Loaded by models/ideal.py:roast_ideal(); scored by models/distance.py:attribute_distance(). Detail: docs/PHASE10_STEP5_5_ALL_ATTRIBUTES.md, docs/PHASE10_STEP3_LABELS.md.

fields.ideal: 10 sensory attribute target intensities (cotter CATA attributes, models.sensory.ATTRIBUTES order). Scale = CATA detection frequency, nominally [0,1]; independent intensities, do NOT sum to 1. Bullseye for the Step 5 attribute-distance.
fields.anchor_brew: the Layer 1 point {tds,ey,roast,dial} the IDEAL was derived from via predict_attributes(). TDS/EY are coarse internal latents (no refractometer); their absolute value barely matters — the system is anchored, so it cancels. Traceability only, NOT a scoring field.
fields.seed: provenance + confidence tier of this roast's IDEAL.

light.seed: User ⭐4 cup matching the user's stated light goal ('乾淨茶感帶酸香' = clean, tea-like, with acidity). Source = the 2026-05-27 logged ⭐4 brew: 98°C / dial 4.8 / 26g / 90s / XL 400ml → TDS 1.194 / EY 16.12 through Phase 10 Layer 1, IDEAL re-derived through the 10-attribute predict_attributes(). RE-ANCHORED 2026-06-04 from the Hoffman archetype (4.3/120/23, which the user later rated ⭐2 — '怪, 沒baseline, 滑') to this ⭐4 cup, chosen after recomputing ALL 17 logged cups on one consistent model scale (models/analysis.py — the old stored TDS/EY were a mix of model versions and not comparable). The four ⭐4 light cups cluster tightly in a box: 高溫 ≥98°C + 短時間 ≤90s + dial 3.5–4.8 + dose 25–26g → TDS 1.19–1.27 / EY 16–18; every ⭐2 broke one wall (dose 28 太濃 / dial 5.5+120s 太粗太長 / 92°C 太冷 / 120s+23g 太長). Within the box this cup (dial 4.8 coarse-end, 90s) is the one the user named as their target; the dial-3.5 ⭐4 siblings they flagged '太厚/沒茶感'. IDEAL shifted RMS 0.019 from the Hoffman version: brighter (Sour +0.031 / Citrus +0.029), less roasty (Bitter −0.023 / Dark.choc −0.022 / Burnt −0.021), thinner body (Thick.viscous 0.044→0.029). Confidence: Tier B — n=1 ⭐4, corroborated by 3 sibling ⭐4 cups in the same hot+short+moderate box. FOLLOW-UP: detect_flags() shows the model over-predicts light Bitter/roast (a Layer 2 calibration item, separate from this anchor move).
light.description: 淺焙（Nordic 真淺焙 / Tim Wendelboe 風）。Burnt/Dark.chocolate 為各焙度最低、Sour/Tea.floral 最高（明亮）、body 最薄（乾淨茶感）。錨定使用者 2026-05-27 ⭐4 杯（98°C / dial 4.8 / 26g / 90s,『乾淨茶感帶酸香』）—— 高溫短時間偏粗的萃取,非細磨厚 body。

medium_light.seed: user ⭐5 feedback cup. Source = the user's logged 'impeccable' (無可挑剔) medium_light brew: 94°C / dial 4.4 / 24g / 150s / XL 400ml, recomputed through the Phase 10 thin Layer 1 → TDS 1.366 / EY 20.11; IDEAL re-derived through the 10-attribute predict_attributes(). Rationale: Hoffman's 'Brewing for Balance' recipe is a respected reference, not an objective optimum — cotter hedonic-liking data shows no single 'best' exists. For a single-user system the authoritative target is the user's own ⭐5 cup. Confidence: Tier A — n=2 mutually consistent ⭐5 cups.
medium_light.description: 中淺焙。校準在使用者實測 ⭐5 杯（94°C/4.4/24g/150s，使用者評『無可挑剔』）。相對 Hoffman 文獻杯更酸、更苦、body 略厚 —— 此為使用者偏好，非文獻平均。

medium.seed: PLACEHOLDER — deterministic: predict_attributes at medium_light's reference brew point (1.3662/20.11/dial 4.4 — the user's ⭐5 cup) with the `medium` roast offset. No anchor, no feedback. Refine when a medium-roast cup is logged.
medium.description: 中焙。佔位用 —— 無錨點、無 feedback，沿 _ROAST_OFFSET 自 medium_light 推得。

moderately_dark.description: 中深焙。佔位用 —— 無錨點、無 feedback，沿 _ROAST_OFFSET 自 medium_light 推得。
